body: Owner asked 2026-11-11. (1) approveCard refuses an agent. (2) Brief line and board badge when an approved file changed since its approval. (3) A comment that calls an actor by @name shows in that actor's brief. (4) Brief finds a lost claim by verb, not in the newest 200 rows.

completion.releaseNote: Only a person can approve a file; the brief and board say when an approved file changed; agents see comments that call them by name.
completion.summary: approveCard is person-only (approve and clear). RepoIndex has an optional sha256 port; the CLI gives it with a size+mtime cache and a 256 MB cap. The brief warns on changed or missing approved files; the board's Memory page shows a badge and hides Approve on an agent's board. Core mentionsOf puts comments that call the actor by name in the brief. ActivityQuery has verb; the brief asks for the day's imports. Checks: lint, typecheck, 773 unit tests (2 skipped, as before), build, 97 Playwright tests. Commit d74c7ef.

title: 9h follow-ups 2: person-only file approval, changed-approval warning, agent mentions in brief, lost-claim query
